messages.subject: Rmarkdown and MS Word
parts:
TLDR; Not getting any error messages but also not getting styling changes when I try to use a reference .docx.  Couldn't find a group specific to rmarkdown or bookdown so posting here.

Starting to get my feet wet using RStudio and Rmarkdown knitting to MS Word.  Have religiously followed both Yihui Xie's vid on vimeo and Richard Layton's great post "Happy collaboration with Rmd to docx" on Rstudio site.  I know YAML indentation can be a PITA and triple checked 2 spaces for and 4 spaces for the two lines below.

  word_document:
      reference_docx: 

Using Ubuntu 16.04, RStudio 1.0.44, Libreoffice 5.2.4.2 and Pandoc 1.16.0.2.

TIA for any trailheads.

V.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Rmarkdown and MS Word
parts:
Sorry to hear you were having trouble with styling Word documents, but
I recorded the video on Windows using MS Word, so I'm not sure if what
I showed could apply to Ubuntu and Libreoffice.

For Libreoffice, perhaps rmarkdown::odt_document is a better choice.
There is a similar option as reference_docx of word_document in
odt_document, named reference-_odt. I have never tried it, though. I
only use Windows and any Office tools (including Open/Libreoffice) for
testing purposes.

Regards,
Yihui
